description: 1-minute OHLC(+volume/OI-like fields) for bitFlyer FX_BTC_JPY pulled from bitFlyer's own public chart backend (lightchart.bitflyer.com), NOT an officially documented API. Built 2026-09-06 as part of the multi-year-history source survey (docs/PHASE2/BITFLYER_HISTORY_SOURCES.md). This is the only source found so far that reaches back years instead of the ~31-day public-trade-history window used for backtest_data/candles_FX_BTC_JPY_31d_20260823.csv.gz.

symbols.FX_BTC_JPY: bitFlyer Lightning FX / Crypto CFD BTC/JPY (the CFD product this repo trades). Full history built 2026-09-06, see backtest_data/bitflyer_lightchart_FX_BTC_JPY_1m_20260906/README.md.
symbols.BTC_JPY: bitFlyer Lightning SPOT BTC/JPY (the underlying cash market bitFlyer's own SFD/funding-rate mechanism references against the CFD price). Added 2026-09-06 (P2-08 blindspot audit item #3, CFD-basis diagnostic) via `scripts/fetch_bitflyer_lightchart.py --symbol BTC_JPY` -- same endpoint/pagination behaviour observed as FX_BTC_JPY (301-redirect, unauthenticated), not independently re-probed beyond that. See backtest_data/bitflyer_lightchart_BTC_JPY_1m_20260906/README.md for actual coverage (a resumable, possibly-partial-at-time-of-writing backfill -- check that README's coverage table, not this description, for the true span).

source.notes: period=h and period=d return HTTP 501 (not implemented) -- only period=m works. The server floors `before` to a 12-hour UTC grid boundary (00:00/12:00) and 301-redirects to the canonical URL with type=full&grouping=1 appended; each canonical page returns <=720 rows (12h of 1m bars), newest row first.

ts.unit: ISO-8601 datetime string (converted from the raw epoch-ms ts_ms field by scripts/build_bitflyer_lightchart_csv.py)

open.meaning: first execution price in the minute
open.notes: null when the minute had zero executions (see known_defects)

high.meaning: max execution price in the minute
high.notes: null when the minute had zero executions

low.meaning: min execution price in the minute
low.notes: null when the minute had zero executions

close.meaning: last execution price in the minute
close.notes: null when the minute had zero executions

volume.meaning: sum of execution sizes in the minute
volume.notes: 0 when the minute had zero executions -- this source does NOT forward-fill a flat bar the way backtest_data/candles_FX_BTC_JPY_31d_20260823.csv.gz does (see schema/candles_fx_btc_jpy.json known_defects); it reports the true gap as null OHLC instead

col7_inferred_long_oi.meaning: INFERRED, not confirmed against bitFlyer documentation -- a large, slowly-drifting number present on rows since ~2017-07; guessed to be an open-interest-like long-side snapshot for the FX product because it does not sum with buy/sell volume and moves gradually bar-to-bar. Treat as unverified.
col7_inferred_long_oi.notes: null on rows from before ~2017-07 (only OHLCV was recorded that far back)

col8_inferred_short_oi.meaning: INFERRED, not confirmed -- same reasoning as col7 but for the short side.

buy_volume.meaning: portion of `volume` from taker-buy executions (inferred from buy_volume+sell_volume==volume on every row checked)

coverage.earliest_seen: 2015-11-28 04:54 UTC in the full-history build (2026-09-06) -- close to, and slightly earlier than, the ~2015-11-30 figure from the original probe (which only checked before=2015-12-01 vs before=2015-11-01 at 12h granularity)
coverage.as_of_this_build: backtest_data/bitflyer_lightchart_FX_BTC_JPY_1m_20260906/ now holds the FULL history walk (7,871 raw 12h pages, stopped on the empty terminal page): 5,662,046 rows, 2015-11-28 04:54 UTC .. 2026-09-06 00:00 UTC. See that directory's README.md for the per-year gap table and full overlap comparison.

known_defects: File layout changed 2026-09-06 (lead pass, after the full-history rebuild below): the single candles_1m.csv.gz (212MB) was split into one candles_1m_YYYY.csv.gz per calendar year (see candles_1m_index.json for row counts/first/last/md5 per year) and the 7,871 raw pages were packed into one raw_YYYY.tar per year, to keep every tracked file under GitHub's 100MB limit. path_glob above matches the new candles_1m_YYYY.csv.gz files; content/columns/row counts are unchanged, only the packaging.
Not an officially documented bitFlyer API -- it is the backend the public web chart calls. Could change or be rate-limited/blocked without notice; no SLA.
col7/col8 semantics are an unverified guess (see column notes above) -- do not use them for anything load-bearing without independent confirmation.

SCHEMA BUG FIXED 2026-09-06: this file previously documented the timestamp column as `ts_ms` (raw epoch milliseconds); the actual CSV column emitted by scripts/build_bitflyer_lightchart_csv.py is `ts` (an ISO-8601 string). scripts/data_quality.py's missing_columns check caught the mismatch (declared_but_absent: ts_ms, undocumented_in_schema: ts) on the 2026-09-06 full-history build. Corrected above; no data file needed to change.

data_quality.py flags on the full-history build (backtest_data/bitflyer_lightchart_FX_BTC_JPY_1m_20260906/candles_1m.csv.gz, run 2026-09-06): zero_volume 295,755 rows (294,741 of these are the documented null-OHLC/zero-execution minutes -- expected for this source, not a defect; the remaining 1,014 have a real non-null close with volume printing as exactly 0.0, plausibly a sub-satoshi-rounding execution size rather than a bad print, not individually root-caused); maintenance_window 1,483 flat (O=H=L=C) bars inside the 19:00-19:10 UTC window (this source nulls true no-trade minutes rather than forward-filling, so a *flat* bar here means a single real execution printed inside the window, not the carried-forward-bar artifact documented for schema/candles_fx_btc_jpy.json); extreme_return 27 rows (|return|>10% between consecutive real bars) -- see the 2017-2018 SFD-era note below, this is where nearly all of them cluster; gaps 69 rows flagged relative to the file's own median 60s cadence, all already enumerated in gaps_gt5min.txt (largest three: 721min on 2026-08-23->24, 185/191min on 2015-11-28, matches the fetch run's own README note -- not individually root-caused); missing_columns -- see the entry above, now fixed.

2017-2018 SFD-era volatility (checked 2026-09-06): of the 27 extreme_return (>10% 1-minute move) rows in the whole file, ~15 fall in 2017-2018, clustering at 2017-02-13 (+12.1%), 2017-05-25 23:20-23:29 UTC (a 4-print round trip: -19.7%/+30.6%/-19.5%/+18.6%, i.e. a sharp spike and reversion within 9 minutes), 2017-11-29 19:23-19:29 UTC (bubble-top volatility, -11.1%/+16.9%), 2017-12-07 (+11.8%), and 2018-01-16 09:34-10:05 UTC (five prints, -20/+20/+14/-12/+40%, matching the Jan-2018 crypto-wide crash). These line up with well-known market-wide events (the Dec-2017/Jan-2018 bubble top and crash) and, for 2017-05-25 and 2018-01-16, with the kind of thin-liquidity single-trade spike-and-reversion bitFlyer's FX_BTC_JPY was documented elsewhere in this repo (schema/candles_fx_btc_jpy.json) to be prone to before the SFD (Sakizuke/divergence) fee mechanism matured -- treated as plausible real prints given the round-trip-within-minutes reversion pattern (a fabricated bad print would not typically reverse this cleanly), not confirmed against an independent contemporaneous source. Not excluded from the data (flag-only, no filtering).

Cross-check against backtest_data/candles_FX_BTC_JPY_31d_20260823.csv.gz on the overlapping month (2026-07-23..2026-08-23): 41,461 minutes comparable (both sources had a real bar), exact OHLC match on 89.5%; close differs by >0.5 JPY on 5.1% of minutes, with a handful of outliers up to several thousand JPY on minutes where volume matches exactly between sources -- suggests the two internal bitFlyer systems (REST candle builder vs. this chart WS-derived feed) do not always bucket the same trades into the same minute, not a bug in our own snapshot. 3,171 minutes are non-null (forward-filled) in our REST snapshot but null (no execution) here, consistent with the REST snapshot's known zero-volume-ffill defect (schema/candles_fx_btc_jpy.json).

Full-overlap cross-check (2026-09-06 rebuild) against backtest_data/fx_btc_jpy_1m_continuous_20260906/candles_1m.csv.gz over that file's ENTIRE span (2026-07-23 12:09 .. 2026-09-05 13:47 UTC, superset of the two prior partial checks): 57,924 comparable minutes (both real), 88.5% exact OHLC match, close differs >0.5 JPY on 5.67%, >100 JPY on 3.36% (1,946 minutes), >1,000 JPY on 504 minutes, max observed diff 16,573 JPY. All 3,171 real-in-continuous/null-in-lightchart minutes are on the frozen_candles_31d_20260823 (REST) side, none on the paper_logs_tape_ws (WS) side, consistent with the REST snapshot's separately-documented ffill defect rather than anything wrong with this source. Net: consistent order of disagreement (~85-90% exact match) against both the REST-built and the WS-tape-built parts of our other bitFlyer snapshot -- treat lightchart as a credible independent OHLCV source, not as ground truth to blindly prefer over either.
